title: Sunset Tour of Multnomah Falls plus Vista House and Other Falls
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
To get the full experience you'll need to be able to walk 1.5 miles. We do have alternatives for those who cannot walk. Call us to learn more.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
An unforgettable tour of the Columbia River Gorge's top 5 waterfalls and the Crown Point Vista House. This tour is specifically timed to appreciate the colorful sunsets at the Vista House- an epic ending to an unforgettable experience. With Waterfall Shuttle the views are better, the crowds are lower and you get an expert guide to show you around in a small group.

We spend 2.5 of the 3.5 hours walking around and exploring each of the waterfall state parks. Plenty of time to take pictures or even dive in and take a 200 foot tall shower. 

Waterfall Shuttle tours are designed to maximize your time in the Columbia River Gorge. We create memorable experiences so that your time with us is some of the best time on your vacation!
